name: AssetManager (map placeable/staged object manager, teStagedObjectMgr)
summary: Per-scene asset/placeable manager: owns the map's staged objects and spawns map placeables (models, lights, sounds...). Two instances in game/session (bare entities 0x80000002/3), one in lobby.
server_relevance: Client world/scene bookkeeping; the server needs the map but not this component.
evidence: Prometheus Component_2_AssetManager.h (teMAP_PLACEABLE_TYPE, TODO teStagedObjectMgr); creator 0x9fbcf0 in scene code region; entities carry only 0x02; no subscribers.

name: MapLight (placeable light, render interfacer)
summary: Lightweight inline scene component for a light placeable: OnCreate installs a render interfacer on scene comp 0x01 (+0x1a8) and sets exactly the flags Prometheus attributes to DynamicLighting; teardown removes the light from the renderer.
evidence: OnCreate 0xa1ac30 sets scene flags 0x100000000000, 0x20000000, 0x10000000000, 0x20000000000 (matches Prometheus 'DynamicLighting always sets in OnCreate' comment) and reads loader element 5; sub-iface teardown 0xa1b490 calls renderer DAT_7ff6517fe3e0 vfunc 0x510; inline size 0x40, zero listed instances because inline; creator 0xa1d330 next to 0x44 baked-model code.

name: MapSound (placeable sound emitter)
summary: Inline component for a sound placeable/one-shot sound entity: installs a render/scene interfacer on 0x01, holds a Wwise sound object handle, and on release frees the sound and deletes its own entity.
added_by: engine (map placeable spawner, type SOUND) / sound spawning

fields.0x20: sound object handle released via FUN_a3bbd0(scene+0x4e8)

evidence: Creator 0xa54610 and OnCreate 0xa54150 sit inside the Wwise module (0xa4xxxx-0xa5xxxx: 'Failed to register WWise Object', AkWindowsIOHook); sub-iface 0xa54350 releases +8 through the scene audio world (+0x4e8) then FUN_7ff6507eff50 deletes the entity; deps 0x01,0x03; inline 0x30.

name: StatescriptWorldEntity (Statescript world-query participant)
summary: Marks entities that take part in Statescript world queries: their creation/deletion raises world-change notifier flags so Statescript target queries re-evaluate. Carries a tiny mirrored struct (STU 0x272898C8, no known fields) plus an entity id at +0x88.
added_by: engine dependency (deps 0x01,0x10; dependency of STUUnsynchronizedMoverComponent 0x7d; default slot on predicted entities with 0x69)
server_relevance: Server must replicate it (mirror slot 0xcc04b0) on player/hero/spawn/predicted entities; semantics of payload unclear.
evidence: Live on 24 entities (controller 0e, hero 3cf, spawn defs 167/176, 7a4) = same set as 0x10/0x7a; PredictedEntitySpawnSystem adds 0x69+0x0e by default; StatescriptSystem OnEntityCreated/Deleting notify(1)/(0x80) for 0x0E entities; read_stu_at comp+0x18 -> 0x272898C8.

name: PlayerIdentity (account id, name, rank)
summary: Mirrored player identity data on the player controller: account DBID, display-name string, ranked level and other profile ints. PlayerNameCacheSystem records id+name into the lobby name cache when it is added.
added_by: loader: player-controller loader FUN_7ff650ce74c0 (STU 0x9c2afc95, mirrored no-field type)

fields.0x18: mirror data STU_304250F1: DBID 25187265, teString F26AF612, u32 06166408, s32 x3, m_rankedLevel s16, s16 3975CC13, s8 A9905A48

server_relevance: Server must replicate it for each player (name/rank/account id) - needed for scoreboard/UI.
evidence: read_stu_at on comp+0x18 -> STU_304250F1 with DBID/teString/m_rankedLevel; ECS_Systems PlayerNameCacheSystem reads +0x90 name and +0xa0 id; only on controller 0x40000001; deps 0x20,0x03,0x14; OnCreate 0xccfc00 registers a data-flow handler (vtable 0x15c6048) on 0x03.

name: MovementImpactTracker (footstep/landing impact state)
summary: Per-mover cache of the last processed movement-state index; MovementImpactEffectSystem raycasts between successive movement states to spawn impact effects and decals.
evidence: ECS_Systems: MovementImpactEffectSystem iterates EA+0xb0+0x240 (0x18), compares 0x12 current index with comp+0x18; size 0x20 trivial vtable; on hero 0x40000002 only.

name: PawnOwnerLink / ViewState (hero->owning player backref)
summary: On the hero/pawn: owning player entity id (+0x18), a small mirrored u64, and camera override views/smoothing used by the camera system.
server_relevance: Client derives +0x18 from 0x20; server only replicates the small mirror field.
evidence: Prometheus Component_1F_Backref; live +0x18 = 0x40000001 on hero; read_stu_at +0x20 -> STU_3BAEF547; OnCreate 0xccc760 registers a 0x03 data-flow handler storing its entity id.

name: SoundImportance (per-hero audio priority)
summary: Per-player audio importance state: the sound system resets and accumulates a weight, scores each hero and assigns high/medium/low importance tiers for Wwise.
evidence: ECS_Systems GameSoundSystem iterates 0x20 entities with 0x21 (list +0x318) and writes +0x20/+0x2c/+0x30; live +0x28 float 1115.9 / +0x2c FLT_MAX; OnCreate stub 0xcfa1e0.

name: DynamicPathdataObstacle
summary: Marks moving/dynamic geometry that invalidates AI navmesh tiles; PathdataRebuildSystem compares cached transform/bounds and pushes dirty tiles to singleton 0x64.
added_by: STU 0x1b54380e (STUMirroredEntityComponent child, no fields) on defs 0x133/0x127/0x5b
server_relevance: Server-side AI pathing only (bots); not needed for players.
evidence: ECS_Systems: iterates EA+0xb0+0x3f0 (0x2a), caches 0x01 transform and 0x12 bounds; deps 0x12,0x29; live entities carry 0x1,0x3,0x4,0x12,0x1c,0x23,0x29,0x2a,0x68 (moving map props).

name: Unknown mirrored component (0x30)

name: PlayerCosmeticsLoadout

name: BakedMapModel (baked instanced/simple map model)
summary: Map placeable static model: installs a scene render interfacer on 0x01 (+0x1a8) and renders baked instanced/simple models once the map world is loaded.

name: CommandFrameClock (current CF singleton)
summary: World singleton holding the command frame currently being simulated (+0x18), its time in ms (CF*16, +0x20) and the simulation phase (+0x28: 1 while stepping CFs, 2 after).
server_relevance: Server-relevant concept: mirrors the 16 ms CF clock the server must run; the component itself is client-local.
evidence: Live: +0x18 advanced 135 in 2.15 s (~62.5 Hz), +0x20 == +0x18*16, +0x28 = 2; FUN_c367d0 sets +0x28=1/2 around the CF loop; ECS_Systems CommandFrameSystem.

name: Camera (view/camera singleton)
summary: World singleton owning the game cameras (main + crosshair camera objects, override views).
evidence: Prometheus Component_4F_Camera; OnCreate 0xcf0710 allocates two 0x9b0/0x9d0 camera objects, reads renderer width/height; pre-destroy frees +0x40/+0x48.

name: StatescriptGlobalVarBag
summary: World singleton wrapping a Statescript variable bag keyed by 0x0D8 Statescript identifier GUIDs; game code reads global identifiers from it.
